title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN DON BOSCO!
description_en: Apartment for sale in one of the newest buildings in the Don Bosco area. The apartment is located on the seventh floor and is organized as follows: A living room + kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. It has a South-West orientation. It comes to the market at a preferential price and becomes habitable for several months. There is a parking post for extra payment. For more information contact us!
